model: Auto (copilot)

Review the current files and provide feedback on their content,structure, and overall quality.
Pease identify any areas that may need improvement or clarification.

Use the copilot-instructions.md file as a guide for your review process.
Make sure to check for consistency,accuracy, and completeness in the files.
Please provide specific examples and suggestions for improvement where applicable.

Also use other best practices and guidelines for code review, such as readability, maintainability, and adherence to coding standards.

Do not examine other files in the repository,only the current files.

End the review with a summary of your findings and recommendations for next steps.
